calibration.rule: ceiling = max(slowest calibration median x 1.35, + 25 ms), rounded up, never below the product budget (the #1639 editor-budget margin)
calibration.cold_start_ms: slowest 786.6 (EPYC 7763) -> 1061.9 -> 1100; hosted CPU classes differ 1.8x on unchanged code (427 Xeon 6975P-C, 470-481 EPYC 9V74, 787 EPYC 7763), so this catches gross regressions only
calibration.typing_ms: slowest 47.9 -> 72.9 -> 75; hosted input is bimodal (#1662), so the +25 ms term decides
calibration.open_10mib_ms: measured 34.5 s (EPYC 7763) to 57 s (Xeon 6975P-C), 35-57x over budget; the ceiling is NOT ratcheted to a broken value and stays at the product budget, so this metric reports FAIL until the open is fixed
